messages.subject: RE: Project Slate - first draft Subscription & Shareholders' Agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Thanks. Deepa and I have marked it up (redline to follow separately). Main points from Thornaby: founder cap down to 1.5x proceeds; claim de-minimis up to £35k; warranty claim period cut to 18 months; and we'd like the restrictive covenant extended to 18 months. Otherwise broadly sensible.

Oliver
